How this works

A practical kitchen companion for Turkish and Mediterranean cooking — designed to be propped up on the counter while you cook. Pick recipes, scale servings, follow numbered steps with built-in timers, and build a shopping list that knows where in Vienna you'll find each ingredient.

Three things to know

  • Add your own. Tap + Add recipe to save anything from your repertoire. Custom recipes get a small badge so you spot them.
  • Personalize. Tap ⚙ Personalize to set what you like — Recommended for you appears at the top of the recipes view.
  • Delete or hide. Open any recipe → Delete. Built-in ones get hidden (restorable from Preferences); your own get deleted properly.

Filters explained

  • 🌶 Spicy / 🍷 Alcohol / 🐟 Seafood / 🥩 Meat / 🌱 Vegan: dietary and content filters. Stack them with the categories above to narrow down.
  • Easy / Medium / Hard: Easy = under 15 min active work, no fancy technique. Hard = multi-step, multi-hour, or precise technique (icli köfte, midye dolma).
  • One filter at a time — they replace each other, not stack. For multi-axis filtering use ⚙ Personalize where you can combine preferences.

Nutrition info

Each recipe shows a calorie estimate per serving that scales with the serving control. If "rough estimate" is shown, the number was computed from ingredient calorie densities — useful for diet ballpark, not for medical accuracy. Spanish tapas and breakfast recipes have explicit nutrition data (kcal + protein + carbs + fat). You can add nutrition for your own recipes in the Add form.

Adding food photos

Each recipe falls back to an emoji if no image is provided. To use real photos: when adding a recipe, paste a publicly accessible image URL (e.g. from Wikimedia Commons, Unsplash, or your own image hosting). The URL must be HTTPS and load without authentication. If the image fails to load, the emoji is shown as fallback.

Hosting this on GitHub Pages

  1. Create a public GitHub repo (e.g. riza-chef).
  2. Rename this file to index.html and upload it to the repo root.
  3. Repo → Settings → Pages → Source: main / root → Save.
  4. After ~1 minute your site lives at https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/
  5. On your phone: open that URL → browser menu → Add to home screen. It now opens like an app.
  6. Your shopping list, preferences, and custom recipes persist locally (per device). They don't sync across devices.

The Vienna shopping logic

  • Everywhere  Spar, Billa, Hofer, Penny, Lidl, MPreis — basics, fresh produce.
  • Larger supermarket  Interspar, Billa Plus, Spar Gourmet — tahin, dried hibiscus, pine nuts, currants, decent olive oil.
  • Turkish grocer  Etsan, Bambi Markt, Brunnenmarkt / Yppenmarkt — nar ekşisi, urfa biber, fine bulgur, kuru bakla, fresh labne, tamarind paste, vine leaves cheap.

Specialty note: Etsan on Praterstraße (1020) and the stalls along Brunnengasse (1160) consistently beat supermarket prices and quality for the Turkish/Middle Eastern items.
